
ADD-EXAMPLE
Add a concrete example to a work unit during Example Mapping

WHEN TO USE
  Use during specifying phase to capture concrete examples that illustrate rules and will become test scenarios.

USAGE
  fspec add-example <workUnitId> <example>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <example> (required)
    Concrete example description

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Add example
  $ fspec add-example AUTH-001 "Login with user@example.com and correct password"
  ✓ Example added successfully

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-rule
  fspec add-question
  fspec generate-scenarios
  fspec remove-example
